title: DNI Anonymizer
description: Upload your DNI to blur sensitive information before sharing. Your image is processed locally in your browser and is never uploaded to any server.
hotelIntro: According to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD), hotels only need to collect specific data for the traveler's entry form. They are not permitted to make a full copy of your ID.
recommendationRedact: We recommend redacting all other data, especially:
dataMrz: The MRZ (Machine Readable Zone at the bottom)
